name: tailor: reserve would target the lowest-weight bullet, but it is the entry's first (core) bullet — next eligible non-core goes
why: Core definition: 'core = the entry's first bullet, or any bullet with "core": true; a core bullet is never replaced'. b1 is index 0 so it is core even though its top competency weight (iac = 1) is the lowest of the three. Eligible non-core bullets are b2 (lang = 2) and b3 (ops = 3); among those 'the bullet with the lowest top competency weight ... goes' → b2 is removed, and its removal 'loses nothing' because b2 holds no JD term. The reserve brings two JD terms the page does not hold (Observability, Incident). Order: 'an entry's core bullets come first, in their master order; the others follow, sorted by how many JD terms they hold (more first, stable)' → b1, then reserve (2 terms), then b3 (0 terms).
